display_long_description:
Play your movies on a real cinema screen, in a theater lit by the picture. Walk through a cabin in the snow and pick up what you find. Put your Mac and your Windows PC on the wall. Free to install, no ads, no account.

YOUR MOVIES
• Headset files and USB drives (NTFS, exFAT)
• Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and Silo, with posters and resume
• NAS: SMB, DLNA, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP
• Your photos, flat, 3D, 180° and 360°

A REAL THEATER
A cinema modeled seat by seat and a 25.7 m giant screen. The movie's colors light the room. Each 5.1 or 7.1 channel plays from the speakers around you.

THE CHALET, FREE
A log house you walk through. Pick things up with your hands or controllers, throw a log in the fire, play a movie on the wall.

YOUR MAC AND YOUR PC
Your desktop in the headset, with its sound. A Mac and a Windows PC at once, up to 3 screens from Windows. Free Lumenoir Link app: lumenoir.app/link

WATCH TOGETHER
Up to 8 friends, each in their own headset, the same movie in sync.

ALMOST EVERY FORMAT
4K, HDR10, HLG. TrueHD, DTS-HD MA, E-AC-3. 3D, VR180, 360°, fisheye. Unprotected DVD and Blu-ray backups. SRT, ASS, PGS subtitles.

FREE TO TRY, UNLOCK ONCE
Free: your files, USB, Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Silo, the Chalet. Premium, a one-time purchase, adds NAS, discs, unlimited 3D and VR, giant screen, cinema sound, light, watching together and your computer. Most of it is free 20 minutes a day.

Sintel, Cosmos Laundromat, Big Buck Bunny, Elephants Dream, Tears of Steel © Blender Foundation (CC BY).
